recipes.name: Nourishing Coconut Milk Oatmeal
instructions: In a saucepan, combine the oats, coconut milk, plant milk, banana, flaxseeds, and cinnamon. Bring to a boil, reduce to a gentle simmer and allow to cook for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally*.
Add more milk if a thinner consistency is preferred, or cook for another couple of minutes to thicken. Stir in the vanilla and remove it from the heat.
Add your favourite toppings, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based milk that is fortified with calcium . * If you were unable to soak the oats overnight, the cooking time will be longer, about 30 to 40 minutes in total. You will also need to add more plant-based milk.

Storage Store premade oatmeal, without toppings, in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days. When re-heating the oatmeal, you may need to add up to an additional ½ cup (120 mL) of plant-based milk to thin out the oatmeal a bit.
